name: momi-animation-backend
comment: Runs on Node 24 in production (pm2). better-sqlite3 is a native module built for that ABI; if you change the Node major version, run `pnpm rebuild better-sqlite3` or the native binding will fail to load (ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED / NODE_MODULE_VERSION mismatch).
comment:coverage: The --check-coverage thresholds in test:coverage are a regression ratchet, not a target. Measured baseline is 64.68/72.71/75.28/64.68; the gates sit ~3 points below it because c8 output drifts by hundredths between runs and a gate inside that drift fails CI on unrelated changes. Raise them deliberately as coverage improves.

scripts.test:coverage: c8 --all --src src --include "src/**/*.ts" --exclude "src/**/*.test.ts" --exclude "src/**/*.integration.test.ts" --exclude "src/topologyLoadTest.ts" --reporter text-summary --reporter json-summary --reporter lcov --reporter html --report-dir coverage/backend --check-coverage --statements 61 --branches 69 --functions 72 --lines 61 node scripts/runBackendTests.mjs
